chapters.title: Arrival
chapters.subtitle: Where the road runs out of map

photos.caption: The road bends out of the fog and keeps going.
photos.alt: Green cliffs under low grey cloud, a narrow road winding along the hillside.

photos.caption: A fjord opens below the cliff edge, deep blue against pale stone.
photos.alt: Aerial view of a deep blue fjord between mountains, seen from a rocky cliff edge.

photos.caption: A weathered door, a green bicycle, nobody home.
photos.alt: A weathered wooden door painted faded teal with a green bicycle leaning beside it.

spreads.quote: Some places are remembered by the light, not the map.

photos.caption: Quiraing, late afternoon
photos.alt: Close view of the winding road cut into green hillside.

photos.caption: Two strokes, then silence.
photos.alt: A person in a red jacket sits in a canoe on a turquoise lake, backed by dark pine forest.

photos.caption: Held still for a moment.
photos.alt: Close portrait of a young woman with curly hair, face turned in soft window light.

photos.caption: Facing the water, away from the camera.
photos.alt: A person in a leather jacket and scarf looks out over a calm sea at dusk.

spreads.quote: The best frames arrive when you stop asking for them.

photos.caption: Left leaning, as it has for years
photos.alt: Detail of a green bicycle against weathered planks.

photos.caption: Gold on everything for ten minutes.
photos.alt: A woman with long hair seen from behind in a golden field at sunset, light flaring through her hair.

photos.caption: Then the sky decided otherwise.
photos.alt: Dark storm clouds with a break of light over a black sea.

photos.caption: Water the colour of a held breath.
photos.alt: Detail of the blue fjord winding between grey mountains.

photos.caption: The long way home.
photos.alt: Detail of the road curving down the green hillside.

photos.caption: Back out onto the lake, nothing to carry.
photos.alt: Wide view of a person in a canoe drifting across a turquoise lake toward the treeline.
